prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal 9:16 fashion portrait of an original adult woman in a bright 1950s-style diner. She has a sleek black high ponytail, defined eyes, glossy lips, and realistic natural skin, and must not resemble a public figure. She wears a yellow long-sleeve high-neck knit blouse, high-waisted black wide-leg trousers, black low-heeled loafers, and carries a small unbranded black handbag. Seat her upright in a red vinyl booth with hands resting naturally, looking calmly to camera. Include turquoise-and-red walls, black-and-white checker floor, pendant lights, abstract framed art without text, and indistinct original adult patrons. Use bright warm retro indoor lighting mixed with soft window daylight, sharp detail, and no logos, posters, neon lettering, or watermark.
